comparison.objective: Close a gate valve fully through successive spoke regrasping versus finely tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated constrained handle regrasp and high-travel rotation versus recessed-key use, collar micro-adjustment, counterholding, and cyclic feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Valve fully closed is implied, but torque/leak/damage thresholds are missing; candidate requires an intermediate calibrated setting proven across two cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared rotation is generic; endpoint valve closure and feedback-driven damping calibration are different tested abilities.
